summary: Helix Energy Solutions Group filed this 8-K to disclose the early termination of the HSR waiting period for its acquisition of Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc. Under the Merger Agreement, a wholly owned subsidiary of Helix will merge with Hornbeck, then the surviving corporation will merge into another Helix subsidiary. The transaction is expected to close in H2 2026, subject to Helix shareholder approval and other customary conditions. No specific price per share, premium, or deal value is stated in this excerpt. Advisors are not named. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory approvals.
